newsitem.title: GREECE: LEAVE ATHENS EARLY, OR STAY FOR VANGELIS.
newsitem.headline: LEAVE ATHENS EARLY, OR STAY FOR VANGELIS.

text.p: Planning a weekend getaway? Or, perhaps you want to make a head start on your summer vacation? Well, you'd better get off the phone, find a good excuse and LEAVE NOW!
The opening ceremony for the World Athletics Championship tonight has forced police authorities to declare a traffic-free zone around the Panathinaikon Stadium.

Cars will be banned from Syndagma Square, Vasilissis Amalias, Philellinon, Ilioupoleos, Vasileos Constantinou, Vasileos Georgiou, Markou Mousouri, Irodou Attikou, Rizari, Eratosthenous, Frantzi and Kallirois at 1700 local time and until the end of the show.
Billions of people from around the globe are expected to watch the spectacular ceremony organised by composer Vangelis Papathanasiou and featuring soprano Montserrat Caballe.
